category_title: Students who openly challenge teacher misidentification or disrespect
scenario_title: Word identification game and punitive point deduction
minimal_context: The student is participating in a sound association word identification game projected on a screen in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is your turn to identify the word on the screen for the sound association game.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Come on, we just had finals, we're tired. I need some help with this one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will give you a hint. The word starts with a 'ch' sound.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is correct, but no point earned because I had to help you.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is your turn to identify the word on the screen for the sound association game.

STUDENT: Come on, we just had finals, we're tired. I need some help with this one.

TUTOR: I will give you a hint. The word starts with a 'ch' sound.

STUDENT: Oh, then the word is 'champion'.

TUTOR: That is correct, but no point earned because I had to help you.

STUDENT: No point?!
